name: 4x Furiosa RNGD: Qwen3-32B about 1100 tok/s aggregate at batch 32 (SDK 2026-03-13)
unit: tok/s aggregate across the batch, 4-card server
methodology: VENDOR, approximate. Same blog and same four-card RNGD server as the batch-64 cell. Qwen3-32B, SDK through 2026-03-13: batch 32 improved from approximately 750 TPS on the 2026-02-14 SDK to approximately 1100 TPS. Aggregate across the batch, not per-user. Prompt and output lengths are not stated.
notes: Prior SDK value of about 750 TPS at batch 32 is kept in this note. Dividing 1100 by 32 gives about 34 tok/s per user if the batch is uniform, which sits inside the blog 20-40 TPS-per-user SLO band, but that division was not measured and is not the stored value.
